native_mjcf:
<mujoco model="camera-slide-and-gimbal">
<option timestep=".001" gravity="0 0 0"/>
<default><geom type="box" contype="0" conaffinity="0"/></default>
<worldbody>
  <geom name="receiver" size=".42 .33 .012" pos="0 0 -.17" rgba=".46 .53 .53 1"/>
  <body name="carriage" pos="0 0 .015" euler="0 0 90">
    <inertial pos="0 0 0" mass=".5" diaginertia=".001 .001 .001"/>
    <joint name="slide" type="slide" axis="0 0 1" armature=".04" damping=".2"/>
    <geom name="block" size=".073 .045 .034" pos=".012 -.014 .016"
          euler="0 0 18" rgba=".83 .29 .07 1"/>
    <body name="gimbal" pos="0 0 .045">
      <inertial pos="0 0 0" mass=".07" diaginertia=".0003 .0003 .0003"/>
      <joint name="pitch" type="hinge" axis="0 1 0" armature=".012" damping=".05"/>
      <geom name="cap" size=".033 .052 .015" pos="-.014 -.005 .020"
            euler="12 0 -17" rgba=".13 .37 .61 1"/>
      <camera name="gimbal-cam" mode="fixed" pos=".28 -.28 .21" xyaxes="1 1 0 -.375 .375 1"/>
    </body>
  </body>
</worldbody>
<actuator>
  <motor name="drive" joint="slide" gear="2" ctrllimited="true" ctrlrange="-5 5"/>
  <motor name="tilt" joint="pitch" gear="1" ctrllimited="true" ctrlrange="-1 1"/>
</actuator></mujoco>
native_reference: MuJoCo CPU integration and independent cam_xpos / cam_xmat, fixed camera mode

physical_veto.injection: explicit pre-commit veto after real GPU step preparation

publication_rejection.SW1: new exposure requires a successful observation refresh
publication_rejection.SW4: new exposure requires a successful observation refresh
publication_rejection.RQ1: new exposure requires a successful observation refresh
publication_rejection.RQ4: new exposure requires a successful observation refresh

observation_retry.injection: controlled fault after actual CUDA body observer, before bank publication

SW1.forged_mount: mounted camera metadata differs from this publication
SW1.expired_exposure: foreign or expired device pose exposure

SW4.forged_mount: mounted camera metadata differs from this publication
SW4.expired_exposure: foreign or expired device pose exposure

RQ1.forged_mount: mounted camera metadata differs from this publication
RQ1.expired_exposure: foreign or expired device pose exposure

RQ4.forged_mount: mounted camera metadata differs from this publication
RQ4.expired_exposure: foreign or expired device pose exposure

contour_reference.domain: single-sample native host RGB8 decoded to display-linear then area averaged; mask from mixed supersample instance IDs including moving geometry

timings.scope: wall ms for two worlds x (fixed + mounted), four synchronous RGB/ID/depth/valid captures; includes host D2H/body and camera composition+uploads, or shared pack/publication+camera metadata; both include returned CPU image planes; physics, source snapshot, oracle and IO excluded

host.capture_scope: successful RGB-requested captures, not ray count or visible shadow pixel count
host.buffer_scope: logical AS and scratch buffer bytes; actual VkDeviceMemory allocation telemetry is separate
host.update_scope: each capture builds or updates TLAS, including two cameras at the same frame key
host.upload_scope: additional VkAccelerationStructureInstanceKHR records, 64 bytes per instance per capture; not the ordinary forward/inverse matrix buffer
host.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final allocation teardown is reported by resident telemetry

shared.capture_scope: successful RGB-requested captures, not ray count or visible shadow pixel count
shared.buffer_scope: logical AS and scratch buffer bytes; actual VkDeviceMemory allocation telemetry is separate
shared.update_scope: one GPU TLAS build or update per acquired matrix publication, shared across its camera draws
shared.upload_scope: instance_upload_bytes counts host TLAS-instance uploads; shared instance records are generated on the GPU
shared.snapshot: last live query, retained after close; final allocation teardown is reported by resident telemetry
shared.instance_source: Vulkan compute over the shared device matrix buffer
